records.public_claim_text: In tier 1, average non-compliance rates in the 2021 Sweep (97%) were higher than in the 2015 Sweep (74%) (Tables 8 and 9).

records.public_claim_text: In the 2015 Sweep, the number of products swept on online marketplaces (346) and retailer websites (312) were similar, however in the 2021 Sweep jurisdictions focused more on online marketplaces (1,069) rather than retailer websites (127).

records.public_claim_text: Further analysis of the unsure responses in tier 2, found that even though it was difficult for jurisdictions to establish whether a product met the labelling and safety information requirements of a standard from visual online inspections alone, in 47% of cases there was some additional safety information within the listing which may assist consumers in assessing the product’s safety.
